body_html:
Build a welcoming waiting area that bends to your floor plan, not the other way around. The Craft square unit is a fully upholstered modular seating cube from the Offices To Go Craft series — one of six geometric shapes and five tables that snap together to shape reception, breakout, and lounge spaces in seconds. Non-handed and easy to move, it lets you reconfigure the room as fast as your needs change.

Features

  • Fully upholstered square cube/pouf, part of the modular Craft lounge series (six seating shapes, five coordinating tables)
  • Non-handed components reconfigure freely — ideal for open and evolving spaces
  • Geometric shapes combine for unique, near-infinite layout possibilities
  • Standard with 1.5" tall nylon glides; optional carpet (C107) or hard-floor (C107R) dual-wheel casters
  • Wide choice of Grade 1, LuxPlus, graded-in, and GPM textiles to match your palette
  • GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold certified for low-emission indoor air quality

Specifications

Measures 20"W x 20"D x 17.5"H with a 17.5" seat height and weighs 22 lbs, rated for users up to 275 lbs. Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group and backed by a 5-year warranty, with 15 years on the metal frame.
